acceptance_rules: CoverageId and axis labels must come from a successfully read live WCS metadata response
no GetCoverage request is constructed from guessed axes or identifiers
numeric sample must be raw WCS elevation rather than rendered symbology
NoData sentinel -3.4028235e+38 is rejected as missing
sample coordinate must be bound to candidate BNG geometry
survey epoch/geoid or composite lineage is retained
DSM values cannot satisfy the ground-elevation requirement
quality_effect: Defines exact fail-closed conditions for accepting a real EA numeric elevation for a bound candidate.
